market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by widespread volume dry-up and volatility compression across all asset classes. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are pinned tightly near intraday supports or Value Area fair-value nodes (POC/VAL) with sub-1.0 RVOL and muted CVD delta flow. US100 is wedged in chop between its EMA50, VWAP, and dealer Put Walls under negative amplifying gamma. BTCUSD is drifting toward Session Low support at 71141 without volume confirmation. In the absence of breakout RVOL spikes or clean liquidity sweeps, all instruments are disciplined HOLDs.

In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is above VWAP (28193.92) but struggling right at EMA50 (28254.03) and below EMA20 (28305.09).
